t: A team robotics competition where students build and program autonomous robots.
steps: Find Botball on the KIPR site and read the program details.
Register a team and ask KIPR about the fee.
Attend an educator workshop between January and March.
Power the Wombat and join its Wi-Fi network from a laptop.
Open the IDE in Chrome or Firefox.
Run a first program on a robot.
Plan the seven to nine week build schedule.
